ref.substituent_description: Spiro carbon shared by an N-Boc pyrrolidine and a five-membered lactam (C=O next to spiro carbon, then lactam N) fused to a pyridine whose ring N is adjacent to the fusion carbon bonded to the lactam N (7-azaoxindole). The lactam N carries CH2 to a benzene bearing OMe para to the CH2.
ref.notes: Typeset. Double bonds: C=O (1), pyridine (3), benzene (3).

wrong.substituent_description: Spiro carbon shared by an N-Boc pyrrolidine and a five-membered lactam (C=O, lactam N) fused to an all-carbon circled benzene ring (oxindole; no ring N). The lactam N carries CH2 to a circled benzene bearing OCH3 para to the CH2.
wrong.notes: Handwritten black ink. Only drawn double bond is C=O. OCH3 written vertically (O above CH3).

correct.substituent_description: Spiro carbon shared by an N-Boc pyrrolidine and a five-membered lactam (C=O, lactam N) fused to a pyridine whose ring N is adjacent to the fusion carbon bonded to the lactam N. Lactam N carries CH2 to a circled benzene bearing OMe para to the CH2.
overlaps_or_ambiguities: C7a=N double bond drawn as a short inner stroke
correct.notes: Handwritten black ink. Pyridine drawn Kekule (3 double bonds), benzyl ring with a circle; plus C=O = 4 double bonds.

errors_in_wrong.description: Reference six-membered fused ring is a pyridine with ring N adjacent to the fusion carbon bearing the lactam N (7-aza position); the wrong drawing omits this N and draws an all-carbon benzene ring, so the 7-azaoxindole becomes an oxindole.
Reference para substituent on the benzyl ring is the abbreviation 'OMe'; the wrong drawing expands it to 'OCH3'.

review_notes: Wrong drawing leaves out the pyridine N (drawn as benzene) and writes OMe as OCH3. Corrected drawing restores the ring N in the right place and uses OMe; everything else matches.
